title: Is This Acquisition a Game Changer for Netflix?
title_zh: 此次收购会改变 Netflix 的游戏规则吗？
summary: At the very least, it didn't cost the company tens of billions of dollars.
summary_zh: 至少，公司没有损失数百亿美元。

title: Replit’s Amjad Masad on the Cursor deal, fighting Apple, and why he’d rather not sell
title_zh: Replit 的 Amjad Masad 谈 Cursor 交易，与苹果作斗争，以及为什么他不愿出售
summary: At TechCrunch's sold-out StrictlyVC event in San Francisco on Thursday night, we covered a lot of ground in a short time, beginning with the question everyone in the industry is asking right now: in a world where rival Cursor is reportedly in talks to be acquired by SpaceX for...
summary_zh: 星期四晚上，在 TechCrunch 在旧金山举办的 StrictlyVC 活动中，座无虚席，我们在短时间内讨论了很多内容，首先是业内每个人现在都在问的问题：据报道，竞争对手 Cursor 正在与 SpaceX 就收购事宜进行谈判……

title: Bloom Energy (BE) Is Up 25.7% After Securing Oracle AI Data Center Power Deal - Has The Bull Case Changed?
title_zh: 获得 Oracle AI 数据中心电力交易后，Bloom Energy (BE) 上涨 25.7% - 牛市情况发生变化吗？
summary: In late April 2026, Bloom Energy Corporation reported first-quarter revenue of US$751.05 million and net income of US$70.65 million, and raised its full-year 2026 revenue guidance to a range of US$3.40 billion to US$3.80 billion.
summary_zh: 2026年4月下旬，布鲁姆能源公司公布第一季度营收为7.5105亿美元，净利润为7065万美元，并将2026年全年营收指引上调至34.0亿美元至38.0亿美元。

title: SoftBank-Tied Deal Raises Nearly $1 Billion for US Data Centers
title_zh: 软银联合交易为美国数据中心筹集近 10 亿美元资金
summary: (Bloomberg) -- A data-center developer sold $999 million of junk bonds for a project leased to a SoftBank Group Corp.
summary_zh: (彭博社) -- 一家数据中心开发商为租赁给软银集团公司的一个项目出售了 9.99 亿美元的垃圾债券。

title: BASF Coatings Launches $2 Billion Debt Sale To Fund Carlyle Acquisition
title_zh: 巴斯夫涂料公司启动 20 亿美元债务出售，为凯雷收购提供资金
summary: This article first appeared on GuruFocus. Banks have moved to launch a debt sale exceeding $2 billion tied to the carve-out of BASF SE's (BASFY) coatings division, a deal that could offer a timely read on investor appetite for chemicals exposure.
summary_zh: 本文首次发表于 GuruFocus。银行已着手启动一项超过 20 亿美元的债务出售，与剥离巴斯夫股份公司 (BASFY) 涂料部门相关，这项交易可以及时了解投资者对化学品敞口的兴趣。
